name: AgeLocator Age Gate
author: Mark Moran

sections.description:
WARNING: This is a cookie-based age gate that can be bypassed in seconds. It provides NO real age verification and is NOT suitable for legal compliance.

This free plugin adds a simple yes/no age popup to your site. Users can bypass it by:
* Clearing cookies
* Using incognito mode
* Disabling JavaScript

When to Use

  • Personal blogs wanting basic age gates
  • Testing before upgrading to real verification

When NOT to Use

  • Adult content sites
  • Sites selling alcohol/tobacco/vaping products
  • ANY site requiring legal age verification

For real AI-powered age verification that meets UK/EU compliance requirements, visit agelocator.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through Plugins menu
  3. Configure under Settings > AgeLocator
  4. Age gate appears automatically
sections.faq:
Can this be bypassed?

Yes, easily. Clear cookies and it’s gone. This is NOT real verification.

Is this legally compliant?

No. This will NOT meet UK Online Safety Act or EU requirements.

Why offer it if it’s useless?

Some sites just want a basic deterrent. Also lets you test before upgrading.
